description:
Delete an unverified brand registration

Deletes a brand whose registration was never verified: one in status otp_required or action_required that has no campaigns. The deletion is final once this returns; the brand is no longer listed, and every route addressing its ID returns BRAND_NOT_FOUND. A deleted brand still counts toward the organization's rolling registration limit.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/10dlc-brands/delete-an-unverified-brand-registration
